messages:
maria-ml: Heads up — seeing a small but consistent drop (~2.6% MRR) on q3b-awq vs float16 on the relevance eval for prompt cohort A. Probably sampling skew in our dev prompts. :thinking:
jamal-eval: numbers? which eval snapshot and which prompt slice?
maria-ml: eval id `2026-03-relevance-v5`, slice=cohort_A_longtail (n=6.2k). baseline float16 MRR 0.842, q3b-awq 0.818. bootstrap p<0.01. attaching `diff_by_bucket.csv` in thread.
sophia-curation: saw this too — that cohort has ~14% near-duplicates after our fingerprint pass, plus a tail of paraphrase variants from same origin sources.
ande-labeler: last label batch 542 had a bunch of near-duplicates we skipped, and two annotators flagged rubric confusion around "partial relevance".
maria-ml: proposal: run a focused micro-golden refresh — 120 canonical longtail items + 40 adversarial paraphrases + 20 ambiguous edgecases. Small annotator pool (3) with adjudication.
jamal-eval: +1. Plan suggestion: (1) curation sample + dedupe with loosened threshold, (2) 3x labeling + adjudication, (3) rerun eval with CI gating. Target 5 business days.
sophia-curation: I can produce sample. Will run `scripts/sample_cohort.py --seed 204 --bucket longtail --n 180 --loosen_dupe=0.85` and upload to `s3://redwood-evals/micro-golden/1998887776/`.
labeler-bot: label batch created: `batch-1998-microgold` assigned to @andre-labeler, @rita-labeler, @sam-labeler.
andre-labeler: on it. will ping if rubric unclear. can we add canonical examples for "partial relevance"?
sophia-curation: yes — adding 6 canonical examples and guidance: prefer binary where possible, otherwise 3-way label + free-text comment.
lena-infra: FYI infra window tomorrow 03:00-06:00 UTC open for q3b-awq runs. tag me when you kick off heavy eval jobs.
jamal-eval: will run `python eval/run.py --model q3b-awq --promptset micro-golden.json --runs 3 --seed 204` and push logs to `gs://redwood-eval-logs/1998/`.
maria-ml: objective: check if delta persists after cleaned micro-golden + adjudicated labels. If yes -> escalate to quant team for kernel/scale diagnostics. If no -> update golden and proceed with rollout.
andre-labeler: started labeling — leaving comments on 11 items (ambiguous math/paraphrase).
maria-ml: thanks. also snapshot tokenization diffs; some paraphrases change token counts a lot which can affect KV cache and latency behaviour.
jamal-eval: created GH issue `quant-eval/1998` with checklist and placeholders for plots + p-values. will update after run.
sophia-curation: sample + docs ETA EOD today. assigning myself to adjudication on Friday.
maria-ml: awesome — :thumbsup: keep updates brief here. ping if blockers or we need extra annotator capacity.
